$comment: What discovery costs on the 386-directory profile (packages/filesystem/src/testing/discovery-profile.ts), held to the measurement by project-directories.discovery-cost.test.ts. `scan` is one full read of every directory with warm handles: the first pass after a reload or a reset of the discovery index (FW2). `warmPass` is a pass with no evidence. `directoryRead` is one directory a warm pass re-reads because evidence marked it. `sweep` is one `verifyAbsent`: a fresh listing of each root and one identity read per directory. `verification` is one targeted route verification. apps/libs/project-library/src/discovery-budget.test.ts holds its ceiling's unit rows to these figures.
